scope: All paper-facing baseline comparisons created after this policy is frozen.
primary_evidence_rule: A numeric value may enter a main comparison or support a SOTA claim only when produced locally from an audited run under the same frozen track contract as AgentEnhance.

allowed_uses: literature context in a clearly separated appendix
prohibited_uses: filling a missing locally reproduced cell
ranking against locally reproduced AgentEnhance values
supporting a best or SOTA claim
mixing values across evaluator, backbone, data split, budget, or denominator

comparison_tracks.backbone_rule: same frozen local answer backbone and revision for every method
comparison_tracks.evaluator_rule: same frozen evaluator, prompt, decoding, sample IDs, denominator, and failure semantics
comparison_tracks.seed_rule: three seeds for stochastic methods; one explicitly deterministic run otherwise

comparison_tracks.evaluator_rule: same frozen evaluator, prompt, decoding, 1711-question denominator, and failure semantics
comparison_tracks.budget_rule: K=10 or a frozen token-equivalent budget reported alongside K

comparison_tracks.backbone_rule: same frozen local answer backbone and revision for every method
comparison_tracks.evaluator_rule: same deterministic scorer and complete frozen denominator
comparison_tracks.seed_rule: three seeds for stochastic methods; one explicitly deterministic run otherwise

result_admission.denominator_rule: n_observed plus n_failed must equal n_expected; failures remain in the denominator.
result_admission.no_result_rule: A missing, rejected, or failed reproduction is shown as such and is never replaced by an official number.

sota_rule: SOTA may be claimed only for an audited best same-track value, or a Pareto-nondominated point under predeclared quality, safety, and efficiency axes. A favorable slice may be shown only when the full aggregate and all frozen slices are also reported.
method_inclusion_rule: The machine-readable register remains broad. The paper main table is a curated subset containing only methods with accepted same-track local reproductions; adapter failures stay in the reproduction appendix.
agentenhance_gate: Do not run AgentEnhance on a public comparison track until at least two recent 2025-2026 non-control methods on that track have accepted local reproductions.
